concerns.text: The plan does not explicitly exclude the raw rating variables (`white_rating`, `black_rating`) from the set of predictors. Since the outcome variable `outcome_deviation` is defined as `actual - elo_expected_prob`, and `elo_expected_prob` is a deterministic function of those same ratings, including the ratings as predictors would make the validation target (outcome deviation) mathematically dependent on the predictors, creating a circular/tautological validation.

The outcome deviation is a bounded, discrete variable (range [-1, 1] with many zeroes). Modeling it with a Gaussian GLM using an identity link (as planned) violates the assumptions of normality and unbounded support, and may produce fitted values outside the feasible range. A more appropriate approach would be a Tobit model, beta‑inflated model, or ordinal regression that respects the bounded nature of the response.
